import json
import re

transcript_path = r'C:\Users\ST\.gemini\antigravity-ide\brain\8b0efe22-55d5-41d2-a34b-f45ae2ea5d5b\.system_generated\logs\transcript_full.jsonl'

with open(transcript_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

pdf_text = ""
for line in reversed(lines):
    try:
        data = json.loads(line)
        if data.get('type') == 'USER_INPUT' and '==Start of PDF==' in data.get('content', ''):
            pdf_text = data['content']
            break
    except:
        pass

# Extract all OCR blocks
ocr_blocks = re.findall(r'==Start of OCR for page \d+==\n(.*?)==End of OCR for page \d+==', pdf_text, re.DOTALL)

items = []
current_brand = "UNKNOWN"

for block in ocr_blocks:
    for line in block.split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
            
        # Ignore headers and footers
        if line.startswith('Stock In Hand') or line.startswith('AL - TOUHEED GARMENTS') or line.startswith('SHOP 2 AND 3') or line.startswith('Sr. No.'):
            continue
        if line.startswith('Class Total:') or line.startswith('Category Total:') or line.startswith('Manf. Total:') or line.startswith('Grand Total:'):
            continue
        if line in ['F/S', 'WTR', 'H/S', 'SHIRT F/S', 'SHIRT H/S', 'TERRY F/S', 'Z-MISS PLACE', '* *CUT.PEICE', '*CUT PEICE*']:
            continue
        if line.startswith('OLD *2025*') or line.startswith('Z-EXACT') or line.startswith('**MISS PLACE**') or line.startswith('*2024*') or line == '2026' or line == '14 AUG H/S':
            continue
        
        # Check if line might be a brand header
        if 'Date:' in line and not line.startswith('SHOP'):
            # Example: AB TRADERS RWP JOURNEY BY LILSOFT BABY Date: 23/07/2026 20:03
            brand_match = re.match(r'^(.*?)\s+Date:', line)
            if brand_match:
                current_brand = brand_match.group(1).strip()
            continue

        # Match item row
        # Example: 1 5081 JOURNEY D-100326 W TO THE WORLD F/S STARTER SET HANGER 84 1,400.00 1,580.00 1
        # Regex to capture Sr No, Alias, Item Name, Qty, Pur Price, Sale Price, P/Unit
        # Sometimes Alias has letters e.g. Z308
        match = re.match(r'^(\d+)\s+([A-Za-z0-9\-]+)\s+(.+?)\s+([\d,]+)\s+([\d,]+\.\d{2})\s+([\d,]+\.\d{2})\s+(\d+)$', line)
        if match:
            sr_no, alias, name, qty, pur_price, sale_price, p_unit = match.groups()
            
            # Clean up numbers
            qty = int(qty.replace(',', ''))
            pur_price = float(pur_price.replace(',', ''))
            sale_price = float(sale_price.replace(',', ''))
            p_unit = int(p_unit)
            
            items.append({
                "sr_no": int(sr_no),
                "alias_name": alias,
                "item_name": name.strip(),
                "qty": qty,
                "purchase_price": pur_price,
                "sale_price": sale_price,
                "p_unit": p_unit,
                "brand": current_brand
            })

with open(r'd:\projects\SHOP\opening_purchase.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(items, f, indent=2)

print(f"Extracted {len(items)} items to opening_purchase.json")
